sentences.text: Jushatyria is classified as an indeterminate archosaur because it possesses an antorbital fossa on the side of its maxilla.
This creature belongs to the class Reptilia and its parent group is listed as Thecodontia.
Fossils of Jushatyria were found in the Koltaevo III Locality near the Ural Mountains in European Russia.
The only known fossil is an incomplete left maxilla designated as holotype PIN 2867/5.
Jushatyria lived during the Ladinian stage of the Middle Triassic.
Researchers Nesbitt and Gower and Sennikov suggested that all fossils attributed to Jushatyria may not belong to a single taxon.
